headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels Carted Off After Reinjuring Left Elbow
summary: In their Week 2 matchup with the division rival Cowboys, the Commanders saw the first half come to a disastrous end. Failing to score before the half from the one-yard line is never ideal, but in the process quarterback Jayden Daniels hurt his left elbow, the same elbow that limited his playing time last year. […]

headline: Jayden Daniels ruled out with left elbow injury
summary: The Commanders quarterback dislocated the same elbow in a November game against the Seahawks in 2025.

headline: Dak Prescott breaks Tony Romo's Cowboys passing TDs record
summary: Dak Prescott became the Cowboys' all-time leader in touchdown passes in Sunday's win over the Commanders, surpassing Tony Romo with 249 in his career.

headline: Kirk Cousins throws three TDs, Raiders start 2-0 with 26-14 victory over Chargers
summary: Klint Kubiak is the first Raiders coach to start his tenure 2-0 since Bill Callahan in 2002.

headline: Aaron Glenn defends clock management after Jets' collapse
summary: The Jets blew their biggest fourth-quarter lead in six years in a 20-17 overtime loss to the Packers, with coach Aaron Glenn facing scrutiny for his clock management.

headline: Ravens preach team's resolve despite another collapse in 4th
summary: The Ravens did not want to draw parallels to past teams after Sunday's loss to the Saints, despite losing in a similar manner with a fourth-quarter lead.
